mcq.s: Which of the following is not an output device?
mcq.x: The mouse is an input (pointing) device; monitor, printer and plotter are output devices.

mcq.s: Which of the following is not an output device?
mcq.x: A touch screen works as both an input and an output device, so it is not purely an output device; monitor, printer and plotter are output devices.

mcq.s: Which of the following is not an output device?
mcq.x: A digital camera is an input device; plotters, monitors and earphones are output devices.

mcq.s: Which one of the following groups has only input devices?
mcq.x: Mouse, keyboard and scanner are input devices; printer, projector and monitor are output devices.

mcq.s: Which is the most common input device used today?
mcq.x: The keyboard (with the mouse) is the most common input device; the motherboard, CPU and semiconductors are not input devices.
